quality_check.description: A standalone vertical charcoal-and-wash scene shows an empty suburban-industrial edge beneath an overcast sky. A garden hose remains attached to a house-side spigot, snakes across wet pavement and grass, and ends beside a broad shallow puddle. Empty homes and roadway recede toward utility poles, transmission structures, power lines, and a hazed electrical substation or industrial skyline. The image uses rough paper grain, soot-like shading, rubbed gray haze, restrained green-gray washes, crisp infrastructure contours, foreground debris, and a dark weathered perimeter with an abraded inner illustration window. No people, characters, captions, labels, UI, or diagrammatic layout are visible.

prompt:
Create one standalone vertical 9:16 WORLD_KEYFRAME establishing a modern post-human world immediately after humanity has vanished. Show an empty suburban edge where an unattended garden hose still runs across wet concrete into a shallow spreading puddle; no people, no characters, no host. Beyond the yard, silent homes and an empty street recede toward utility poles, transmission lines, and a distant substation, suggesting systems still running but beginning to fail. Keep the moment eerie, plausible, and restrained—not catastrophic spectacle.

Render entirely in cinematic charcoal with subtle diluted ink wash for water, haze, and distant structural silhouettes. Use rough fibrous charcoal paper, weathered concrete-like grain, soft soot bloom, rubbed graphite haze, restrained water-stain mottling, broken architectural edges, selective crisp dark contours on key infrastructure, and fine scratches for cables, weeds, cracks, and debris. Palette: desaturated storm gray, soot black, concrete beige, oxidized blue-green, dead moss green, dirty ivory, with only sparse cold-amber remnants of failing artificial light. Lighting: overcast cinematic daylight slipping toward dim emergency gloom, long soft shadows, misty atmospheric falloff.

Maintain the recurring frame language: a weathered charcoal-and-concrete outer field with irregular soot-darkened edges and a softly abraded inner illustration window, as though the scene is rubbed into a stained architectural drawing board; foreground wet ground and debris, readable midground yard/street, hazed infrastructure beyond. Fill the full illustration height naturally—no caption reserve, blank strip, panel, or low-detail band.

No photorealism, CGI, anime, neon, vector infographic style, readable text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, grids, sheet layouts, swatches, or technical diagrams. Reference image is style/medium anchor only; do not copy its composition. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: every 9:16 body image sits inside a recurring weathered charcoal-and-concrete outer field with irregular soot-darkened edges and a softly abraded inner illustration window, as if the abandoned scene has been rubbed into a stained architectural drawing board; the central image retains cinematic depth with foreground debris or vegetation, a readable midground event, and hazed infrastructure beyond, while the same worn perimeter and charcoal vignette grammar persist throughout the episode. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI. Binding isolation: no recurring host, no selected host, and no foreground person or character.
